documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 with revenue from operations reaching INR121 crores, marking a 60% year-on-year growth driven by robust consumer demand and retail expansion. EBITDA stood at INR18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while profit after tax was reported at INR9 crores. Management detailed upcoming store launches in Surat and Rajkot for Q2 and Q3, and emphasized a long-term strategic shift toward expanding its retail footprint and transitioning inventory toward Gold Metal Loans and hedging. RBZ Jewellers Limited reported an investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting a year-on-year revenue growth of approximately 60% and an EBITDA margin of 14.9%. Management noted that revenue performance was in line with guidance shared in the previous quarter, supported by customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and brand recall.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is expected to reach 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term, with 75% being retail.
guidance.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: Delivered a healthy quarterly performance, with revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: Delivered a healthy quarterly performance, with revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

guidance.claim: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IIJS received a warm and encouraging response with good buyer growth and order backing, keeping performance in line with projections.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that July and August order kitties are full due to successful appreciation of designs from the corporate end.
demand_outlook.quote: because of which the July, August order kitty are full. So right now, company is very much in line with the orders that we are receiving, and I hope that the response continues further.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the growth momentum in Q4 FY26 was supported by festive demand, particularly during the Akshay Tritiya season.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth momentum was supported by festive demand, particularly during Akshay Tritiya season.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that April has been very good in terms of business performance.
demand_outlook.quote: Now how has been April? April has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced store launches in Surat for Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar for Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that inventory deployment in large format stores is around INR125 crores to INR150 crores and in small format stores around INR50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores. While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the capex incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities like Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA for the quarter was INR18 crores with EBITDA margins at 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that profit after tax for the quarter was INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA increased by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Management estimates inventory gains to be around INR10 crores to INR12 crores for the year.
margins_costs.quote: I think assuming that around INR10 crores to INR12 crores or INR10 crores to INR11 crores or INR12 crores should be an inventory gain number.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year with production consumption around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year. And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs.

orders_capacity.claim: The wholesale business has a presence in 72+ cities across 20 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Presence in 72+ cities across 20 states, serving marquee clients including Titan, Malabar Gold, and Senco Gold.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in the occasion wear segment.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio,

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for FY26 is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the debt-to-equity ratio will still remain below 1:1 by the end of this financial year, around 0.8 debt to 1 equity.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that restrictions such as customs duty increases and advanced authorization on gold imports are not advantageous, and they are studying actual ground level impact.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an expectation to achieve capex break-even for the new stores in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix will become 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an expectation that by the end of the year, at least 20% of corporate sales mix will be of 18 caratage.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
